title: 第702章 大只一点的雌小鬼也很可爱第701章 是师尊先冲师的我们只不过是学习而已
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
温蝶衣连忙摇头，那摇头的动作幅度不大，却极为坚定，两条麻花辫在她肩后轻轻晃动，尾梢带起几滴温热的水珠洒在水面上，激起一圈圈极细极小的涟漪。
她抬起眼帘迎上江尘羽那审视的目光，语气平静而笃定地说道，声音里没有了方才刚入水时那份紧张与拘谨，反而多了几分自信与从容。
“你确定？”
江尘羽的眼眸里浮现起一抹怀疑之色，那怀疑毫不掩饰，明晃晃地写在他微微蹙起的眉头和略微眯起的眼眸里。
他有理由怀疑，自家乖巧的徒孙是为了自己能够早点回到红颜身边鬼混才说的这话。
毕竟蝶衣这孩子太过懂事了，懂事到会为了不给别人添麻烦而委屈自己的程度。
他记得很清楚，方才在大殿中分配房间时，诗钰说要和她一起住，她明明心里高兴得不行，嘴上却还说“不用，蝶衣自己一个人睡一个房间也可以”。
“确定！”
温蝶衣迎上师祖那充满怀疑的目光，没有闪躲，没有心虚，只是用力地点了点头。
很快，少女抬起手，用食指的指尖极轻极轻地戳了戳江尘羽搭在她肩头的那只手的手背，语气里带着几分罕见的撒娇意味：
“师祖您要不先把手给拿开？让蝶衣自己试一试。”
“好。”
江尘羽微微颔首，那双深邃的眼眸在蝶衣脸上停留了几息，似乎在最后一次确认她不是在逞强。
然后他缓缓松开了搭在她肩头的五指，将手从她肩上移开。
一旦他发现任何不对劲的地方，那只手便会在第一时间重新覆上她的肩膀。
而也是在这个瞬间，原本还对那股生命能量十分渴望的魔气顿时又变得桀骜不驯了起来。
失去了江尘羽魔气印记的持续供给，那些生命之力重新被魔气识别为外来的入侵者。
那头方才还热情地簇拥着生命之力的暗金色凶兽，此刻再次竖起了无形的壁垒，开始试图将那些残留的生命之力驱逐出去。
它们在温蝶衣体内不断地奔腾肆虐，如同被囚禁了许久终于找到出口的困兽，暗金色的魔气细流在她的经脉中横冲直撞，每一次撞击都让她的经脉微微一颤。
甚至让少女原本因为温泉浸润而变得红润的面色都多了几分苍白。

那苍白以肉眼可见的速度从她的脸颊蔓延到嘴唇，这与池边氤氲的热雾形成了触目惊心的反差。
但是温蝶衣没有在乎这些。
她的眉头只是极轻极轻地蹙了一下便重新舒展开来，那自控力远远超出了她这个年纪该有的程度。
她没有向江尘羽求助，甚至没有发出一声闷哼，只是自顾自地运转着修炼的功法。
她闭上眼睛，将意识沉入丹田深处，主动引导着那些被江尘羽标记过的、还残留着些许魔气印记的生命之力，让它们去安抚那些躁动的魔气。
很快，魔气的躁动又归于平静。
那头暗金色的凶兽重新蜷缩回丹田深处，不再对外来的生命之力横加阻拦。
那些碧绿色的生命能量终于能够顺畅地在她经脉中流淌，从经脉汇入丹田，又从丹田流向四肢百骸，沿途所过之处都带着一种暖融融的舒适感。
并且将生命力的涌入与自身吸收维持在一个平衡的状态。
“居然真的可以，蝶衣，你怕是个怪物吧？”
江尘羽将方才那整个过程从头到尾都看在眼里。
从他撤手的那一刻，到她面色骤然苍白，到她闭眼运转功法，再到魔气重新归于平静，整个过程前后不过数十息的时间。
这份适应速度，这份对体内两股截然相反力量的自控能力，完全超出了他的预期。
他扬起眉毛，用好奇的目光注视着温蝶衣，语气里带着几分不加掩饰的惊叹。
作为天魔之体的拥有者，他自然知道这鬼体质到底有多难搞。
天魔之体对任何外来力量都有着天然的排他性，这种排他性在修为尚低时尤为明显。
content_en:
Wen Dieyi quickly shook her head. The movement of her head was not large, but extremely firm. The two braids swayed gently behind her shoulders, and the tail tips brought a few drops of warm water to sprinkle on the water, causing circles of very small ripples.
She raised her eyes to meet Jiang Chenyu's scrutinizing gaze, and spoke in a calm and determined tone. Her voice was no longer as nervous and reserved as when she first entered the water, but was more confident and calm.
"Are you sure?"
A hint of suspicion appeared in Jiang Chenyu's eyes. The suspicion was undisguised and clearly written on his slightly frowned brows and slightly narrowed eyes.
He had reason to suspect that his well-behaved disciple said this just so that he could return to Hongyan's side as soon as possible.
After all, the kid Dieyi is too sensible, so sensible that he would aggrieve himself just to avoid causing trouble to others.
He remembered clearly that when they assigned a room in the main hall, Shiyu said that he wanted to live with her. She was obviously very happy, but she still said, "No, Dieyi can sleep in a room by herself."
"OK!"
Wen Dieyi met her master's suspicious gaze, without evading or feeling guilty, she just nodded vigorously.
Soon, the girl raised her hand and gently poked the back of Jiang Chenyu's hand on her shoulder with the tip of her index finger. There was a rare hint of coquettishness in her tone:
"Master, why don't you take your hand away first? Let Dieyi try it on his own."
"Okay."
Jiang Chenyu nodded slightly, his deep eyes lingering on Dieyi's face for a few breaths, as if confirming for the last time that she was not trying to show off.
Then he slowly released his fingers from her shoulders and removed his hands from her shoulders.
As soon as he noticed anything was wrong, his hand would immediately cover her shoulder again.
And it was also at this moment that the demonic energy that was still eager for that life energy suddenly became unruly again.
Without the continuous supply of Jiang Chenyu's demonic mark, those life forces were once again recognized by the demonic energy as foreign intruders.
The dark golden ferocious beast that had been enthusiastically surrounding the power of life just now erected an invisible barrier again and began to try to expel the remaining power of life.
They kept running wildly inside Wen Dieyi's body, like a trapped beast that had been imprisoned for a long time and finally found an exit. The dark golden devilish flow was rushing through her meridians, and every impact made her meridians tremble slightly.
Even the girl's complexion, which was originally rosy due to the hot spring soaking, became a little pale.
The paleness spread from her cheeks to her lips at a speed visible to the naked eye, which formed a shocking contrast with the dense heat mist by the pool.
But Wen Dieyi didn't care about this.
Her brows only furrowed slightly and then relaxed again. Her self-control was far beyond what she should have at her age.
She didn't ask Jiang Chenyu for help, she didn't even let out a groan, she just continued to practice her skills on her own.
She closed her eyes, sinking her consciousness deep into her dantian, and actively guided the life force that had been marked by Jiang Chenyu and still had some traces of demonic energy to soothe the restless demonic energy.
Soon, the restlessness of the demonic energy calmed down again.
The dark golden ferocious beast curled back into the depths of Dantian, no longer blocking the outside power of life.
The green life energy was finally able to flow smoothly through her meridians, flowing from her meridians into her Dantian, and then from her Dantian to her limbs, bringing a warm and comfortable feeling wherever she passed along the way.
And maintain a balanced state between the influx of vitality and its own absorption.
"It's really possible, Dieyi, are you afraid you're a monster?"
Jiang Chenyu watched the entire process from beginning to end.
From the moment he withdrew his hand, to the sudden paleness of her face, to the moment she closed her eyes and started running her power,The whole process only takes a few dozen breaths before the magic energy returns to calm.
This speed of adaptation, this ability to control the two completely opposite forces in his body, completely exceeded his expectations.
He raised his eyebrows and stared at Wen Dieyi with curious eyes, with a hint of undisguised exclamation in his tone.
As the owner of the devil's body, he naturally knows how difficult this devil's physique is.
The body of the demon has natural exclusivity towards any external force. This exclusivity is especially obvious when the cultivation level is still low.
